notes.title: Update V1.0.1 is now available
notes.notes:
Before starting, a few important notes:

[list]
[*]Some translations are still missing, but we wanted to update the game first and we can still patch the V1.0.1 version on Steam with new translations.
[/list] 
[list]
[*]In order to improve the player experience, the production team decided to update A.D. 2047 on June 23rd. This update focuses on fixing the problem of game equipment adaptation in the previous version, and optimizing the operation guidance; At the same time, community items such as STEAM exchange cards will be added.
[/list]	


Here is the update of version V1.0.1

[b]-	Add new Windows MR devices (Only support Samsung Odyssey+ MR)[/b]

[b]-	Provides an introduction to the operation of Oculus, HTC VIVE, Value Index and Windows MR (only Samsung's MR is supported) in Chinese, English and Japanese. Players can choose freely according to the actual situation.[/b]

Operation guidance of players after entering the game:

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40370156/f7f8a78c36b97a353a88baca9616ee89e58d124c.png[/img]


Added Oculus Series Equipment operation guide

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40370156/4b264c023f3e6e46bb189ee7df23fa3cf0e7e63d.png[/img]
 

Added HTC VIVE operation guide

 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40370156/410d1755bf8549f6cfd42d9f3834b18282d5f994.png[/img]
 

Added Valve Index operation guide

 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40370156/03ee69f7ad71dc3708bbbf956f39c7e46daa1173.png[/img]
 

Added Windows MR operation guide (only supports Samsung Odyssey+ MR)

 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40370156/d1b2b5e5856986618e4383dbe5ed8d25dba08297.png[/img]
 


[b]-	Fixed the problem that the game had no sound after Oculus Quest 2 was streamed.[/b]

Please note: When Quest2 devices are streaming with VirtualDesktopStreamer, the following actions will still cause the game to have no sound.

(1) when the 1)AudioStreaming option is Don't stream audio, the game will have no sound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40370156/d004137f42d2489c78ebdb6e9127f8153f49bc2c.png[/img]

(2) After deselecting the Use virtual audio driver, select any option in the AudioStreaming bar, and the game will have no sound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40370156/56c58a2eba87c291a289ba6ce0b994e949182c4e.png[/img] 


[b]-	Fixed some game blocking bugs, which are not listed here.[/b]


[b]-	Add community items such as Steam exchange cards and medals.[/b]

The Steam set-and-exchange card is now turned on and dropped, and the badge, chat expression and profile background can be obtained when the card is synthesized.


-Leenzee Games
